test_title: PYST 43: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All hammers are jacks.

All hammers are metals.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some jacks are metals.

(II) All metals are hammers.
solution:
**Statements:****
All hammers are jacks.

All hammers are metals.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b35c0fc92930205dbced931d2c6f12af3dd1a5a886fed19cea45828a87fa692.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some jacks are metals. - Follow** (Because, all hammers are jacks and all hammers are metals, which means some jacks being hammers are metals.)

(II) All metals are hammers. - Does not follow (Because, all hammers are metals which means some metals are hammers.)

Thus, only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
